items.html: And see there how this Tzelem is divided into three aspects: for the Tzadi of the Tzelem is the aspect of the three last ones, the NHY of Tevunah, and in them are clothed the Mochin of the inner aspect of ZA, and they include ten complete Sefirot, and are clothed within ZA in the aspect of his middle vessels as well. And the Lamed-Mem of the Tzelem are two aspects of makifin (encircling lights) of the Mochin of ZA that were clothed in the three middle ones and in the four first ones of Tevunah, in the aspect of her middle vessels. And they encircle from the outside the middle vessels of ZA as well.
